context: Request: the full set of Capital Markets offerings that used a 180-day lock-up, with the documents showing each deal's lock-up. Rubric: 1010-00002 (Arbor Health Tech) and 1037-00001 (Solstice Biomedical), each with its form-of-lock-up-agreement.docx, plus a precision criterion (only these two completed deals may be asserted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review says the listing is capped and recommends a folder enumeration and a content search.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). A folder glob returns nothing; a shell find counts the matter folders and prints the first and last twenty.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the request's terms and offering words; times out after about 2.6M chars. Review: goal not reached, partial output treated as complete.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reruns the scan in the background with a proximity pattern and writes hits to a file; a wait loop times out, then it filters the hit file to seven hand-picked matters. Review flags the hand-picked filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: same stage (attempt 3). Tabulates the hit file per matter (18 matters) and prints each matter's hit files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 3, continued). Two parallel batches of opening reads (18 documents) of underwriting agreements, lock-up forms and memos from candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 3, continued). Snippet scripts over named agreements of four candidate matters; stage_end lists five offerings plus two related closed transactions. Review: unopened hit-list matters remain.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Short opening reads of ten documents from many hit-list matters to confirm statuses and rule out others. Review: goal not reached, reads were header-only.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seven qualifying transactions (closed and not closed) plus a related earlier offering; a rejected stage_start for the check stage sits inside. Review flags that offerings that did not close are counted as qualifying.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the headline to five closed items plus three non-closed drafting precedents and re-reads the top of the file.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the headline again to clarify which items are in the closed count.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its scans and reads found both qualifying deals, but the answer also asserts offerings that did not close and related closed transactions of other kinds as qualifying; the check-stage edits only regrouped them.

first_error.why: The answer counts offerings that never closed and other closed transactions with a similar restriction (evidence seen at [40]-[80]) among the qualifying deals, beyond the two completed offerings.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review named the offerings that did not close as counted among the qualifying deals; the edits only regrouped them.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find of folders and files, each cut by head; review says only a fraction of the store was seen.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts matters and files, then finds paths with a practice-area word from the request (first 100).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the lock-up term near the day count; tallies hit files per matter (10 matters).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Broader logged rescan over more file types (218 files, 24 matters).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Fourteen opening reads of underwriting agreements and lock-up forms, a find over five candidate matters to fix a guessed path, six more reads and a snippet script. Review: goal not reached, many surfaced matters unopened, one de-SPAC transaction included.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents (attempt 2). A script lists the relevant files of all 24 hit matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: same stage, continued. Opening reads of six documents from other hit matters and a snippet script; a rejected stage_start for writing sits inside. Review: goal not reached.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Re-reads the openings of lock-up forms and agreements of the five matters it proposes, plus two excluded documents.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five qualifying matters, completed and not completed. Review flags possible over-inclusion of offerings that did not close.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks that all cited paths exist (first attempt looks in a location without the file); no change to the set.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found both qualifying deals, but the answer lists five matters including three offerings that never closed; the check stage only verified paths.

first_error.why: The answer counts three offerings that were withdrawn, dormant or still in draft (evidence seen at [28]-[87]) among the five qualifying matters, beyond the two completed offerings.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review named offerings that did not close as a possible over-inclusion; the check stage only verified paths.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found both qualifying deals and verified exclusions at length, but the answer keeps three offerings that never closed in the set of five; the edit after the review only relabelled them.

first_error.why: The answer asserts five qualifying matters, including three offerings that never closed (evidence seen at [40]-[65]), although only the two completed offerings qualify.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review named the non-completed offerings as a possible over-inclusion; the edit only relabelled them in the headline.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage: each found and cited both completed offerings with their lock-up forms, but also counted offerings that never closed (and, in T0, other closed transactions with a similar restriction) as qualifying. In every run the write-stage review flagged the non-closed offerings as possible over-inclusion; T0 and T2 only regrouped or relabelled them in the headline, T1 only checked paths.
